source.text: תְּהִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥דאֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ אֱלוֹהַ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: A praise of David. I will exalt you, my God, the King, and I will bless your name forever and ever.

en.L: A praise of David. I will exalt {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, my God, the King, and I will bless {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name forever and ever.
en.B: A song of praise. Of David. My God, the King, I will lift {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} high in praise and bless {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name for ever and ever.
en.R: A song of praise. By David. My God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the King! I will tell how great {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are. I will always praise {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, forever and ever.

fr.L: Louange de David. Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}exalterai, mon Dieu, le Roi, et je bénirai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom à tout jamais.
fr.B: Un chant de louange. De David. Mon Dieu, le Roi, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}élèverai bien haut par ma louange et je bénirai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom pour toujours et à jamais.
fr.R: Un chant de louange. De David. Mon Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} le Roi ! Je dirai combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand. Je louerai toujours {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, pour toujours et à jamais.

sw.L: Sifa ya Daudi. Nitakutukuza, Mungu wangu, Mfalme, nami nitalibariki jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} milele na milele.
sw.B: Wimbo wa sifa. Wa Daudi. Mungu wangu, Mfalme, nitakuinua juu kwa sifa na kulibariki jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} milele na milele.
sw.R: Wimbo wa sifa. Wa Daudi. Mungu wangu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mfalme! Nitawaambia watu jinsi ulivyo mkuu. Nitalisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} daima, milele na milele.

es.L: Alabanza de David. Te ensalzaré, Dios mío, el Rey, y bendeciré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por siempre jamás.
es.B: Canto de alabanza. De David. Dios mío, el Rey, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} exaltaré con alabanzas y bendeciré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por los siglos de los siglos.
es.R: Canto de alabanza. De David. Dios mío, ¡{{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el Rey! Contaré lo grande que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres. Siempre alabaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, por siempre jamás.

vi.L: [Một] lời ca ngợi của Đa-vít. Tôi sẽ tôn cao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, là Vua, và tôi sẽ chúc tụng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi.
vi.B: Bài ca ngợi. Của Đa-vít. Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, là Vua, tôi sẽ ca ngợi tôn cao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và chúc tụng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi.
vi.R: Bài ca ngợi. Của Đa-vít. Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Vua! Tôi sẽ nói lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại biết bao. Tôi sẽ luôn ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đời đời mãi mãi.

decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: a praise: a song of praise (tehillah)
decisions.reason: This is the only psalm whose title calls it "a praise" (tehillah). The plural of the same word, tehillim, "praises", is the Hebrew name of the whole book of Psalms.

The psalm is an acrostic: its verses begin with the letters of the Hebrew alphabet in order, from aleph (verse 1) to taw (verse 21). The line for the letter nun, which should come after verse 13, is missing from the Hebrew text (see the note on verse 13).
When people bless God (barakh), they do not give him anything; they praise him and speak of his goodness (103:1).
Balanced and Readable say what kind of praise is meant: the psalm is a song.

decisions.choice: My God, you are the King! I will tell how great you are
alternatives: I will exalt you, my God, the King
decisions.reason: Readable turns the title "the King" into a short statement and says what it is to exalt God: to say how great he is.

decisions.choice: "Louange" at Literal for tehillah; "Un chant de louange" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: This is the only psalm titled tehillah, "a praise". Literal keeps the bare noun; the other levels say it is a song of praise, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "[Một] lời ca ngợi" (L); "Bài ca ngợi" (B, R) for the title tehillah
decisions.reason: The title is not the usual word for a psalm but "a praise" (see the meaning decision); Literal keeps that, and Balanced and Readable say "a song of praise", as the English does, to keep it apart from "thi thiên".

source.text: בְּכָל־י֥וֹם אֲבָרֲכֶ֑ךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: In every day I will bless you, and I will praise your name forever and ever.

en.L: Every day I will bless {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and I will praise {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name forever and ever.
en.B: Day after day I will bless {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and give praise to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name for ever and ever.
en.R: I will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} every single day. I will keep on praising {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name forever and ever.

fr.L: Chaque jour je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bénirai, et je louerai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom à tout jamais.
fr.B: Jour après jour je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bénirai et je louerai {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom pour toujours et à jamais.
fr.R: Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louerai chaque jour. Je continuerai de louer {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, pour toujours et à jamais.

sw.L: Kila siku nitakubariki, nami nitalisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} milele na milele.
sw.B: Siku baada ya siku nitakubariki na kulisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} milele na milele.
sw.R: Nitakusifu kila siku. Nitaendelea kulisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} milele na milele.

es.L: Cada día {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bendeciré, y alabaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por siempre jamás.
es.B: Día tras día {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bendeciré y alabaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por los siglos de los siglos.
es.R: Te alabaré cada día. Seguiré alabando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre por siempre jamás.

vi.L: Mỗi ngày tôi sẽ chúc tụng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và tôi sẽ ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi.
vi.B: Ngày qua ngày tôi sẽ chúc tụng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi.
vi.R: Ngày nào tôi cũng sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tôi sẽ cứ ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi.

decisions.choice: your name: you as you have made yourself known
decisions.reason: God's name stands for God himself as he has shown who he is (5:12; 9:11).
Readable uses "praise" for both verbs, since blessing God means praising him (145:1).

source.text: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝לִגְדֻלָּת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: Great [is] YHWH and praised exceedingly, and to his greatness there [is] no searching.

en.L: Great [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to be praised exceedingly, and to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} greatness [there is] no searching.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great, worthy of the highest praise, and there is no searching out the depth of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} greatness.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great! He deserves all our praise. No one can ever find the end of how great {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is.

fr.L: Grand [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et digne d’être loué hautement, et à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grandeur [il n’y a] pas d’exploration.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand, digne de la plus haute louange, et nul ne peut sonder la profondeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grandeur.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand ! Il mérite toutes nos louanges. Personne ne pourra jamais trouver la fin de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grandeur.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mkuu na mwenye kusifiwa sana, na ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} [hauna] kuchunguzika.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu, anastahili sifa za juu kabisa, na hakuna awezaye kuchunguza kina cha ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu! Anastahili sifa zetu zote. Hakuna mtu awezaye kufikia mwisho wa ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

es.L: Grande [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y digno de suprema alabanza, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} grandeza [es] inescrutable.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande, digno de la más alta alabanza, y no hay manera de sondear lo profundo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} grandeza.
es.R: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande! Merece toda nuestra alabanza. Nadie podrá llegar nunca al final de lo grande que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] vĩ đại và rất đáng được ca ngợi, và sự vĩ đại của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [thì] không thể dò xét được.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật vĩ đại, đáng được ca ngợi tột bậc; sự vĩ đại của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sâu thẳm không ai dò thấu.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật vĩ đại! Ngài đáng được chúng ta hết lòng ca ngợi. Không ai có thể tìm ra giới hạn sự vĩ đại của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: praised exceedingly: deserving to be praised highly
decisions.reason: The form (mehullal) is "praised"; it can say that he is praised or that he is to be praised. The same line stands in 48:2 and 96:4.

decisions.choice: there is no searching: it can never be fully explored
decisions.reason: Nothing is beyond his greatness: no search can reach its limit (Job 11:7; Isaiah 40:28).

decisions.choice: No one can ever find the end of how great he is
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m2).

source.text: דּ֣וֹר לְ֭דוֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ יַגִּֽידוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Generation to generation will laud your works, and your mighty deeds they will declare.

en.L: Generation to generation will laud {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mighty deeds they will declare.
en.B: Each generation will praise {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works to the one after it and announce {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mighty acts.
en.R: Parents will tell their children about the things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done. They will tell about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} powerful acts.

fr.L: Génération à génération vantera {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres, et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} hauts faits, ils les annonceront.
fr.B: Chaque génération célébrera {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres devant la suivante et annoncera {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} actes puissants.
fr.R: Les parents raconteront à leurs enfants ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait. Ils parleront de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} actions puissantes.

sw.L: Kizazi kwa kizazi kitazisifu kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, na matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} makuu watayatangaza.
sw.B: Kila kizazi kitazisifu kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kwa kizazi kinachofuata na kuyatangaza matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} makuu.
sw.R: Wazazi watawaambia watoto wao mambo uliyoyatenda. Watasimulia matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yenye nguvu.

es.L: Generación a generación celebrará {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras, y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} hechos poderosos anunciarán.
es.B: Cada generación alabará {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras ante la siguiente y anunciará {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} hechos poderosos.
es.R: Los padres les contarán a sus hijos las cosas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho. Hablarán de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} hechos poderosos.

vi.L: Đời này sang đời kia sẽ ca tụng các công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và chúng sẽ rao truyền những việc quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Thế hệ này sẽ ca tụng công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho thế hệ sau, và công bố những việc quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Cha mẹ sẽ kể cho con cái nghe những việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm. Họ sẽ kể về những việc quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.reason: The verb (shibbach) means to praise or extol; with "to generation" it pictures each generation praising God's works to the one that follows (78:4).
The word (gevurot) is acts that show strength, such as God's acts of rescue for Israel (106:2).
Readable makes the passing on from one generation to the next concrete: older people telling younger ones.

source.text: הֲ֭דַר כְּב֣וֹד הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וְדִבְרֵ֖י נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] splendor of [the] glory of your majesty and [the] matters of your wonders I will meditate on.

en.L: The splendor of the glory of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} majesty, and the matters of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders, I will meditate on.
en.B: I will reflect on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} majesty, its glory and splendor, and on the story of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders.
en.R: I will think about how glorious and majestic {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are. I will think about the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done.

fr.L: La splendeur de la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} majesté, et les récits de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles, je les méditerai.
fr.B: Je méditerai sur {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} majesté, sa gloire et sa splendeur, et sur le récit de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles.
fr.R: Je penserai à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gloire et à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} majesté. Je penserai aux choses étonnantes que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites.

sw.L: Fahari ya utukufu wa enzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, na habari za maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, nitazitafakari.
sw.B: Nitaitafakari enzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, utukufu wake na fahari yake, na habari za maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Nitafikiri jinsi ulivyo mtukufu na mwenye enzi. Nitafikiri juu ya mambo ya ajabu uliyoyatenda.

es.L: El esplendor de la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} majestad, y los relatos de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas, meditaré.
es.B: Reflexionaré en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} majestad, en su gloria y su esplendor, y en la historia de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas.
es.R: Pensaré en lo glorioso y majestuoso que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres. Pensaré en las cosas asombrosas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho.

vi.L: Sự huy hoàng của vinh quang uy nghi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và các sự kỳ diệu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi sẽ suy gẫm.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ suy gẫm về sự uy nghi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, về vinh quang và vẻ huy hoàng của sự uy nghi ấy, và về câu chuyện những việc kỳ diệu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ suy nghĩ về việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vinh hiển và uy nghi biết bao. Tôi sẽ suy nghĩ về những việc kỳ diệu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.

decisions.choice: the splendor of the glory of your majesty: your glorious and majestic splendor
decisions.reason: Three words for greatness are piled up (hadar, kavod, hod) to say that God's majesty is beyond words.

decisions.choice: the matters of your wonders: your wonderful works and the words that tell them
decisions.reason: The word (devarim) can mean words or matters. Here it may be the accounts of God's wonders, or simply the wonders themselves.
The verb (siach) means to think something through and also to talk about it (77:13; 105:2).

decisions.choice: I will meditate: the Hebrew text
alternatives: they will speak (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "I will meditate". The ancient Greek translation has "they will speak" in the first half and "they will tell" in the second, as in verses 6 and 11. The renderings follow the Hebrew text.

source.text: וֶעֱז֣וּז נוֹרְאֹתֶ֣יךָ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְדוּלָּתְךָ֥ אֲסַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] might of your awesome [deeds] they will tell, and your greatness I will recount it.

en.L: And the might of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} awesome [deeds] they will tell, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} greatness, I will recount it.
en.B: People will speak of the power of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fearsome deeds, and I will tell of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} greatness.
en.R: People will talk about the powerful and frightening things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done, and I will tell how great {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are.

fr.L: Et la puissance de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} [actes] redoutables, ils la diront, et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grandeur, moi, je la raconterai.
fr.B: On parlera de la puissance de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} actes redoutables, et moi, je raconterai {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grandeur.
fr.R: Les gens parleront des choses puissantes et terribles que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites, et moi, je dirai combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand.

sw.L: Na nguvu za [matendo] {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ya kutisha wataisimulia, na ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, nitautangaza.
sw.B: Watu watazungumza juu ya nguvu za matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ya kutisha, nami nitatangaza ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Watu watazungumza juu ya mambo yenye nguvu na ya kutisha uliyoyatenda, nami nitawaambia jinsi ulivyo mkuu.

es.L: Y el poder de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} [obras] temibles dirán, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} grandeza, yo la contaré.
es.B: La gente hablará del poder de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras temibles, y yo contaré {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} grandeza.
es.R: La gente hablará de las cosas poderosas y temibles que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho, y yo contaré lo grande que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres.

vi.L: Và người ta sẽ nói về quyền năng của những [việc] đáng sợ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và sự vĩ đại của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi sẽ thuật lại.
vi.B: Người ta sẽ nói về quyền năng của những việc đáng kinh sợ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và tôi sẽ thuật lại sự vĩ đại của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Người ta sẽ nói về những việc mạnh mẽ và đáng sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm, và tôi sẽ kể ra {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại biết bao.

decisions.choice: your greatness: the words follow the form to be read
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes this word in one form and its notes say to read it in another; the written form is plural, "your great deeds", and the form to be read is singular, "your greatness". The renderings follow the form to be read; the meaning is nearly the same.

decisions.choice: your awesome deeds: deeds that make people afraid
decisions.reason: The word (nora'ot) is from the verb "fear": things so great that they cause awe and dread, like the acts at the Exodus (Deuteronomy 10:21).
"They" is anyone who sees God's works, as in verse 4. The psalmist joins them ("I will recount").
Balanced and Readable name who "they" are (m3).

source.text: זֵ֣כֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ֣ יַבִּ֑יעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] remembrance of [the] abundance of your goodness they will pour forth, and [of] your righteousness they will shout for joy.

en.L: The memory of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} abundant goodness they will pour forth, and [of] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness they will shout for joy.
en.B: They will spill over with the memory of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great goodness and sing out for joy at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness.
en.R: People will remember how very good {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are, and they will not be able to stop talking about it. They will sing happily about how {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} always do what is right.

fr.L: Le souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grande bonté, ils le feront jaillir, et [de] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice ils crieront de joie.
fr.B: Ils déborderont du souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grande bonté et chanteront avec joie {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice.
fr.R: Les gens se souviendront combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es bon, et ils ne pourront pas s’arrêter d’en parler. Ils chanteront avec joie que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais toujours ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Kumbukumbu ya wingi wa wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wataibubujisha, na [juu ya] haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} watapiga kelele za furaha.
sw.B: Watafurika kwa kumbukumbu ya wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mwingi na kuimba kwa furaha juu ya haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watu watakumbuka jinsi ulivyo mwema sana, nao hawataweza kuacha kuzungumza juu ya hilo. Wataimba kwa furaha juu ya jinsi unavyotenda yaliyo haki daima.

es.L: El recuerdo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} abundante bondad proclamarán a raudales, y [de] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia gritarán de alegría.
es.B: Desbordarán con el recuerdo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gran bondad y cantarán con alegría por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia.
es.R: La gente recordará lo bueno que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres, y no podrá dejar de hablar de ello. Cantarán felices de cómo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} siempre haces lo correcto.

vi.L: Kỷ niệm về sự tốt lành dư dật của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng sẽ tuôn tràn ra, và [về] sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng sẽ reo hò vui mừng.
vi.B: Người ta sẽ tuôn tràn lời nhắc lại sự tốt lành lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và reo hò vui mừng vì sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Người ta sẽ nhớ lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tốt lành biết bao, và họ sẽ nói về điều đó mãi không thôi. Họ sẽ vui vẻ ca hát về việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn làm điều công chính.

decisions.choice: remembrance: the memory and the telling of it
decisions.reason: The word (zekher) is a memory kept alive by being spoken about.

decisions.choice: pour forth: bubble over, speak freely
decisions.reason: The verb (nava') is used of a spring gushing water (Proverbs 18:4) and of words that pour out (19:3).

decisions.choice: righteousness: God doing what is right
decisions.reason: God's righteousness (tsedaqah) is his faithfulness to do what is right, which often means rescuing his people (71:15).

decisions.choice: they will not be able to stop talking about it
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of a spring that overflows (m2).

decisions.choice: how you always do what is right
decisions.reason: Readable says what righteousness means here (m3).

source.text: חַנּ֣וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וּגְדָל־חָֽסֶד׃

records.literal_gloss: Gracious and compassionate [is] YHWH, long of anger and great of loyal love.

en.L: Gracious and compassionate [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, slow to anger and great in loyal love.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is full of grace and compassion, slow to anger and great in loyal love.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is kind and tender. He does not get angry quickly, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love is great.

fr.L: Bienveillant et plein de compassion [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, lent à la colère et grand en amour loyal.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est plein de grâce et de compassion, lent à la colère et riche en amour fidèle.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon et tendre. Il ne se met pas vite en colère, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle est grand.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwenye neema na mwenye huruma, mwenye kuchelewa kukasirika na mkuu katika upendo usiokoma.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amejaa neema na huruma; huchelewa kukasirika na ni mkuu katika upendo usiokoma.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema na mpole. Hakasiriki upesi, na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma ni mkuu.

es.L: Clemente y compasivo [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, lento para la ira y grande en amor leal.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está lleno de gracia y compasión, es lento para la ira y grande en amor fiel.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bondadoso y tierno. No se enoja fácilmente, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel es grande.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đấng đầy ân điển và thương xót, chậm giận và giàu tình yêu thương thành tín.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy ân điển và lòng thương xót, chậm giận và giàu tình yêu thương thành tín.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhân từ và dịu dàng. Ngài không dễ nổi giận, và tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao.

decisions.reason: The LORD's description of himself to Moses (Exodus 34:6), repeated through the Bible (86:15; 103:8; Joel 2; Jonah 4:2).

decisions.choice: long of anger: slow to become angry
decisions.reason: Anger was pictured by the nose (the same word, 'af), and a "long" nose is anger that is slow to rise.
The word (chesed) is love that keeps faith, the commitment God has bound himself to toward his people (Exodus 34:6-7). Literal and Balanced say "loyal love".
As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.
Readable uses plain words for the two qualities: grace that gives freely and the tender love of a parent (raham is related to the word for the womb).

decisions.choice: "ân điển và thương xót" (L, B); "nhân từ và dịu dàng" (R)
alternatives: "nhân từ và thương xót" at every level
decisions.reason: The words recall God's name in Exodus 34:6 (see the meaning decision). "ân điển" is the key term for grace; Readable says it in plain words, as the English Readable says "kind and tender".

source.text: טוֹב־יְהוָ֥ה לַכֹּ֑ל וְ֝רַחֲמָ֗יו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Good [is] YHWH to all, and his compassions [are] over all his works.

en.L: Good [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to all, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} compassions [are] over all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} works.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is good to everyone; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} compassion covers all that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is good to everyone. He shows tender love to everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made.

fr.L: Bon [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} envers tous, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} compassions [sont] sur toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} œuvres.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon envers tous ; {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} compassion s’étend sur tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon pour tout le monde. Il montre un amour tendre à tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwema kwa wote, na huruma {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} [ziko] juu ya kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema kwa kila mtu; huruma {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} inavifunika vyote alivyoviumba.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema kwa kila mtu. Huonyesha upendo mwororo kwa kila kitu alichokiumba.

es.L: Bueno [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} con todos, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} compasión [está] sobre todas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} obras.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bueno con todos; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} compasión alcanza a todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bueno con todos. Muestra amor tierno a todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] tốt lành với mọi người, và lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] trên mọi công việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tốt lành với mọi người; lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bao trùm mọi loài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tốt lành với mọi người. Ngài bày tỏ tình thương dịu dàng với mọi vật {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên.

decisions.choice: his compassions: his tender love, shown again and again
decisions.reason: The plural (rachamim) is the usual form for compassion; it is the same root as "compassionate" in verse 8.

decisions.choice: over all his works: reaching all he has made
decisions.reason: His compassion rests on every creature, not only on Israel; verses 15-16 show it in the food he gives to all that lives.

source.text: יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יךָ יְבָרֲכֽוּכָה׃

records.literal_gloss: They will thank you, YHWH, all your works, and your faithful [ones] will bless you.

en.L: All {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works will give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful [ones] will bless {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} works will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful people will bless {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, everything {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Your faithful people will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Toutes {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendront grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} fidèles {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} béniront.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, toutes {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} œuvres {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercieront, et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} fidèles {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} béniront.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remerciera. Tes fidèles {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} loueront.

sw.L: Kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote zitakushukuru, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} watakubariki.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kazi {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote zitakushukuru, na watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} waaminifu watakubariki.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kila kitu ulichokiumba kitakushukuru. Watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} waaminifu watakusifu.

es.L: Todas {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darán gracias, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} fieles {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bendecirán.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, todas {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} obras {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darán gracias, y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} fieles {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} bendecirán.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dará gracias. Tu pueblo fiel {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabará.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mọi công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chúc tụng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mọi loài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chúc tụng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mọi vật {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: all your works: all that God has made
decisions.reason: Creation itself gives thanks by what it is, as in 19:2 and 148; God's faithful people give thanks in words.

decisions.choice: the faithful: people of loyal love
decisions.reason: The word (chasidim) is related to chesed, loyal love: people who hold fast to the LORD in love and loyalty (4:4).

source.text: כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ֣ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] glory of your kingdom they will speak, and your might they will tell,

en.L: The glory of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} kingdom they will tell, and [of] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} might they will speak,
en.B: They will speak of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} glorious reign and tell of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power,
en.R: They will talk about how glorious {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} kingdom is. They will tell about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power.

fr.L: La gloire de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} règne, ils la diront, et [de] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance ils parleront,
fr.B: Ils parleront de la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} règne et raconteront {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance,
fr.R: Ils diront combien {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} royaume est glorieux. Ils parleront de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance.

sw.L: Utukufu wa ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} watausimulia, na [juu ya] uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} watanena,
sw.B: Watazungumza juu ya utawala {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wenye utukufu na kusimulia uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}},
sw.R: Watazungumza jinsi ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ulivyo mtukufu. Watasimulia habari za uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

es.L: La gloria de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} reino dirán, y [de] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder hablarán,
es.B: Hablarán de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} glorioso reinado y contarán {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder,
es.R: Hablarán de lo glorioso que es {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} reino. Contarán {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder.

vi.L: Họ sẽ nói về vinh quang của vương quốc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và họ sẽ thuật lại quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Họ sẽ nói về vương quyền vinh hiển của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và thuật lại quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Họ sẽ nói về vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vinh hiển biết bao. Họ sẽ kể về quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: your kingdom: your rule as King
decisions.reason: The word (malkhut) is the royal rule of God more than a territory. Verses 11-13 speak of the kingdom four times; the psalm opened with "my God, the King".
Verse 12 gives the purpose of this telling, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.
"They" are the faithful of verse 10.

decisions.choice: "vương quốc" (L, R), "vương quyền" (B) for God's kingdom
decisions.reason: The kingdom is God's rule as King (see the meaning decision). "vương quốc" says kingdom plainly; Balanced says "vương quyền" (royal rule), as the English Balanced says "reign".

source.text: לְהוֹדִ֤יעַ׀לִבְנֵ֣י הָ֭אָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָ֑יו וּ֝כְב֗וֹד הֲדַ֣ר מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: to make known to [the] sons of humankind his mighty deeds and [the] glory of [the] splendor of his kingdom.

en.L: to make known to the sons of humankind {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mighty deeds and the glory of the splendor of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} kingdom.
en.B: to make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mighty acts known to all people, and the glorious splendor of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} reign.
en.R: They want all people to know about the powerful things God has done and how glorious and wonderful {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} kingdom is.

fr.L: pour faire connaître aux fils des humains {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} hauts faits et la gloire de la splendeur de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} règne.
fr.B: pour faire connaître à tous les humains {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} actes puissants et la splendeur glorieuse de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} règne.
fr.R: Ils veulent que tout le monde sache les choses puissantes que Dieu a faites, et combien {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} royaume est glorieux et merveilleux.

sw.L: ili kuwajulisha wanadamu matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} makuu na utukufu wa fahari ya ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: ili kuyajulisha matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} makuu kwa watu wote, na fahari tukufu ya utawala {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Wanataka watu wote wajue mambo makuu ambayo Mungu ametenda na jinsi ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ulivyo mtukufu na wa ajabu.

es.L: para dar a conocer a los hijos de la humanidad {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hechos poderosos y la gloria del esplendor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reino.
es.B: para dar a conocer a toda la gente {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hechos poderosos y el glorioso esplendor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reinado.
es.R: Quieren que toda la gente sepa de las cosas poderosas que Dios ha hecho y de lo glorioso y maravilloso que es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reino.

vi.L: để cho con cái loài người biết những việc quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và vinh quang của sự huy hoàng của vương quốc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: để mọi người được biết những việc quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và vẻ huy hoàng vinh hiển của vương quyền {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Họ muốn mọi người biết những việc quyền năng Đức Chúa Trời đã làm, và vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vinh hiển, tuyệt diệu biết bao.

decisions.reason: The psalm turns from speaking to God ("your kingdom") to speaking about him ("his kingdom"), because these words are what is told to other people.

decisions.choice: the sons of humankind: human beings
decisions.reason: "Sons of adam" is an ordinary way of saying people, men and women (11:4).
Readable starts a new sentence, so it names who wants this, the faithful of verse 10, and names God, whom the Hebrew calls "his".
Malkhut is God's rule as King, as the meaning decision says; "règne" says the rule, "royaume" is the plainer word for young readers, as the English Readable says "kingdom".

source.text: מַֽלְכוּתְךָ֗ מַלְכ֥וּת כָּל־עֹֽלָמִ֑ים וּ֝מֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ֗ בְּכָל־דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: Your kingdom [is] a kingdom of all ages, and your dominion [is] in every generation and generation.

en.L: Your kingdom [is] a kingdom of all ages, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} dominion [is] in every generation and generation.
en.B: Your kingdom is a kingdom for all the ages, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rule lasts through every generation.
en.R: Your kingdom will never end. You will rule over people in every age that will ever come.

fr.L: Ton règne [est] un règne de tous les siècles, et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} domination [est] dans toute génération et génération.
fr.B: Ton règne est un règne pour tous les siècles, et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} domination dure de génération en génération.
fr.R: Ton royaume ne finira jamais. Tu régneras sur les gens de toutes les époques qui viendront.

sw.L: Ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [ni] ufalme wa zama zote, na utawala {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [uko] katika kila kizazi na kizazi.
sw.B: Ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ni ufalme wa zama zote, na utawala {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unadumu katika kila kizazi.
sw.R: Ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} hautakwisha kamwe. Utawatawala watu katika kila kizazi kitakachokuja.

es.L: Tu reino [es] reino de todos los siglos, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dominio [es] por todas las generaciones.
es.B: Tu reino es un reino para todos los siglos, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dominio dura por todas las generaciones.
es.R: Tu reino nunca se acabará. Reinarás sobre la gente de todas las épocas que vendrán.

vi.L: Vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] vương quốc của mọi thời đại, và quyền cai trị của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [còn] từ đời nọ sang đời kia.
vi.B: Vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là vương quốc muôn đời, và quyền cai trị của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn mãi qua mọi thế hệ.
vi.R: Vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bao giờ chấm dứt. Ngài sẽ cai trị loài người trong mọi thời đại sẽ đến.

decisions.choice: the missing nun line: the Hebrew text has none
alternatives: God is faithful in his words and kind in all his works (the ancient Greek translation and a Dead Sea scroll)
decisions.reason: After this verse, the line beginning with the letter nun is missing from the Hebrew text, and the Hebrew alphabet goes on with samekh in verse 14. The ancient Greek translation and the Psalms scroll from cave 11 at Qumran have a line here beginning with nun: "Faithful is God in his words, and kind (or holy) in all his works". Its second half is the same as verse 17. It may be an original line that was lost, or one written later to fill the gap. The renderings follow the Hebrew text.
The plural ('olamim) means all the ages of time, without end.
The doubled word (dor vador) means one generation after another without end.

source.text: סוֹמֵ֣ךְ יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־הַנֹּפְלִ֑ים וְ֝זוֹקֵ֗ף לְכָל־הַכְּפוּפִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Supporting [is] YHWH for all those who fall, and raising up all those who are bowed down.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] supporting all those who fall, and raising up all those [who are] bowed down.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} holds up everyone who stumbles and raises all who are bent low.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} helps everyone who falls. He lifts up everyone who is weighed down with trouble.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] soutenant tous ceux qui tombent, et redressant tous ceux [qui sont] courbés.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soutient tous ceux qui trébuchent et redresse tous ceux qui sont courbés.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aide tous ceux qui tombent. Il relève tous ceux qui sont écrasés par leurs malheurs.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwenye kuwategemeza wote wanaoanguka, na kuwainua wote [walioinamishwa].
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwashika wote wanaojikwaa na kuwainua wote walioinama chini.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} humsaidia kila anayeanguka. Humwinua kila mtu aliyelemewa na taabu.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sostiene a todos los que caen, y levanta a todos los [que están] encorvados.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sostiene a todo el que tropieza y levanta a todos los que están doblegados.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ayuda a todo el que cae. Levanta a todo el que está agobiado por los problemas.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng] nâng đỡ mọi người sắp ngã, và đỡ dậy mọi người bị cúi khom.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nâng đỡ mọi người vấp ngã và đỡ dậy mọi người bị đè khom xuống.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ mọi người bị vấp ngã. Ngài nâng dậy mọi người đang bị khó khăn đè nặng.

decisions.reason: The verb (samakh) is to lean a hand on something and so to hold it up (37:17, 24).

decisions.choice: bowed down: bent over under a load
decisions.reason: The word (kefufim) is people bent down by grief or hardship; the same words "raises up the bowed down" are in 146:8.
Readable says what bends them low (m2).

source.text: עֵֽינֵי־כֹ֭ל אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּ֑רוּ וְאַתָּ֤ה נֽוֹתֵן־לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] eyes of all to you look in hope, and you [are] giving to them their food in its time.

en.L: The eyes of all look to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in hope, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} give them their food in its time.
en.B: All eyes are turned to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in hope, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} provide their food when it is needed.
en.R: Every living thing looks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and waits. You give them their food at just the right time.

fr.L: Les yeux de tous se tournent vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} avec espoir, et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur donnes leur nourriture en son temps.
fr.B: Tous les regards sont tournés vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} avec espoir, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur donnes leur nourriture quand il le faut.
fr.R: Tous les êtres vivants se tournent vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et attendent. Tu leur donnes leur nourriture au bon moment.

sw.L: Macho ya wote yanakuelekea {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kwa tumaini, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} unawapa chakula chao katika majira yake.
sw.B: Macho yote yanakuelekea {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kwa tumaini, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} unawapa chakula chao wakati kinapohitajika.
sw.R: Kila kiumbe hai kinakutazama na kungoja. Unawapa chakula chao kwa wakati unaofaa kabisa.

es.L: Los ojos de todos esperan en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} les das su comida a su tiempo.
es.B: Todos los ojos se vuelven a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} con esperanza, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} les das su alimento cuando lo necesitan.
es.R: Todo ser vivo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} mira y espera. Tú les das su comida en el momento justo.

vi.L: Mắt của muôn loài trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho chúng thức ăn đúng thời.
vi.B: Mắt muôn loài đều hướng về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trông đợi, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban thức ăn cho chúng đúng lúc cần.
vi.R: Mọi loài có sự sống đều trông lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và chờ đợi. Ngài ban thức ăn cho chúng đúng lúc.

decisions.reason: Almost the same words describe every creature waiting for God to feed it in 104:27-28.
The verb (sibber) is to wait with hope for what is to come (104:27).
"All" here includes the animals, as "every living thing" in verse 16 shows.
Readable says who "all" are (m3).

source.text: פּוֹתֵ֥חַ אֶת־יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַשְׂבִּ֖יעַ לְכָל־חַ֣י רָצֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: Opening your hand and satisfying to every living [thing] [its] desire.

en.L: [You are] opening {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand and satisfying every living [thing with its] desire.
en.B: You open {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand and give every living creature what it longs for.
en.R: You open {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand wide and give every living creature all it wants.

fr.L: [Tu] ouvres {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main et rassasies tout vivant [selon son] désir.
fr.B: Tu ouvres {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main et donnes à tout être vivant ce qu’il désire.
fr.R: Tu ouvres grand {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main et donnes à tout être vivant tout ce qu’il veut.

sw.L: [Wewe] unaufungua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kukishibisha kila [kiumbe] kilicho hai [kwa] matakwa [yake].
sw.B: Unaufungua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kumpa kila kiumbe hai kile anachokitamani.
sw.R: Unaufungua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kabisa na kumpa kila kiumbe hai yote anayoyataka.

es.L: [Tú] abres {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano y sacias el deseo de todo ser viviente.
es.B: Abres {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano y das a toda criatura viviente lo que anhela.
es.R: Abres bien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano y das a toda criatura viviente todo lo que quiere.

vi.L: [Ngài] mở tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra và làm thỏa nguyện mọi loài sống.
vi.B: Ngài mở tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra và ban cho mọi loài sinh vật điều chúng mong ước.
vi.R: Ngài mở rộng bàn tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và ban cho mọi sinh vật mọi điều chúng cần.

decisions.choice: desire: what it wants, its fill
decisions.reason: The word (ratson) usually means favor or goodwill, but here it is what each creature longs for. Some read it as "with favor": God feeds them out of goodwill.
An open hand gives generously (Deuteronomy 15:8, 11).

source.text: צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־דְּרָכָ֑יו וְ֝חָסִ֗יד בְּכָל־מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Righteous [is] YHWH in all his ways, and faithful in all his works.

en.L: Righteous [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways, and faithful in all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} works.
en.B: In all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is righteous; in all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} deeds {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is faithful.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} does what is right in everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does. He is loving and loyal in all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} acts.

fr.L: Juste [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} voies, et fidèle dans toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} œuvres.
fr.B: Dans toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} voies {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est juste ; dans toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} actions {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est fidèle.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait ce qui est juste dans tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait. Il est plein d’amour et loyal dans toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} actions.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwenye haki katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote, na mwaminifu katika kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote.
sw.B: Katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwenye haki; katika matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yote ni mwaminifu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hutenda yaliyo sawa katika kila kitu anachofanya. Ni mwenye upendo na mwaminifu katika matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yote.

es.L: Justo [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos, y fiel en todas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} obras.
es.B: En todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es justo; en todas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} obras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es fiel.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hace lo correcto en todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace. Es amoroso y leal en todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} actos.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] công chính trong mọi đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và nhân từ trong mọi công việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Trong mọi đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đều công chính; trong mọi việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều nhân từ.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm điều công chính trong mọi việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm. Ngài yêu thương và trung tín trong mọi hành động của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.reason: The word (chasid) is the one used for God's faithful people in verse 10, from chesed, loyal love. Used of God (as in Jeremiah 3:12) it means that he acts with loyal love.

decisions.choice: ways: the paths he takes, what he does
decisions.reason: God's "ways" are his actions and the way he deals with people (18:31).
Readable says what "righteous" means.

decisions.choice: "nhân từ" (L, B) for the word the English gives as "faithful"; "yêu thương và trung tín" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word here is the one for a person of loyal love, loyal and kind (see the meaning decision). "thành tín" alone would lose the kindness; "nhân từ" keeps it, and Readable says both, as the English Readable says "loving and loyal".

source.text: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: Near [is] YHWH to all who call him, to all who call him in truth.

en.L: Near [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to all who call [on] {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, to all who call [on] {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in truth.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is close to everyone who calls to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, to all who call to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} sincerely.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is close to everyone who prays to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He is near to all who pray to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and mean it.

fr.L: Proche [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appellent, de tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appellent en vérité.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est près de tous ceux qui crient vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, de tous ceux qui crient vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sincèrement.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est près de tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} prient. Il est proche de tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} prient vraiment, du fond du cœur.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [yuko] karibu na wote wanaomwita, na wote wanaomwita kwa kweli.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko karibu na kila anayemlilia, na wote wanaomlilia kwa moyo mnyofu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko karibu na kila mtu anayemwomba. Yuko karibu na wote wanaomwomba kwa moyo wote.

es.L: Cercano [está] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a todos los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} invocan, a todos los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} invocan en verdad.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está cerca de todo el que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llama, de todos los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llaman con sinceridad.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está cerca de todo el que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ora. Está cerca de todos los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} oran de corazón.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ở] gần mọi người kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mọi người kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cách chân thật.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở gần mọi người kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tất cả những ai kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với lòng thành thật.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở gần mọi người cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài ở gần tất cả những ai thật lòng cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.reason: The word ('emet) is truth and also faithfulness. To call on God "in truth" is to call with a sincere heart, not with words alone (Isaiah 29:13).

decisions.choice: call him: call to him for help
decisions.reason: To call on God is to pray to him, especially in need (verse 19).
Readable uses the everyday word for calling on God.

source.text: רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָ֥יו יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְֽאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָ֥ם יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] desire of those who fear him he does, and their cry he hears and he saves them.

en.L: The desire of those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does, and their cry {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hears, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves them.
en.B: He grants what those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} desire; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hears their cry for help and rescues them.
en.R: He gives people who honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} what they want. When they cry for help, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hears and saves them.

fr.L: Le désir de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’accomplit, et leur cri, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’entend, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les sauve.
fr.B: Il accomplit le désir de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} entend leur appel au secours et les délivre.
fr.R: Il donne aux gens qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorent ce qu’ils désirent. Quand ils appellent au secours, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les entend et les sauve.

sw.L: Matakwa ya wale wanaomcha hutimiza, na kilio chao husikia, na huwaokoa.
sw.B: Huwapa wanaomcha kile wanachotamani; husikia kilio chao cha msaada na kuwaokoa.
sw.R: Huwapa watu wanaomheshimu kile wanachotaka. Wanapolilia msaada, husikia na kuwaokoa.

es.L: El deseo de los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} temen {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cumple, y su clamor {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} oye, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los salva.
es.B: Él concede lo que desean los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} temen; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} oye su clamor y los rescata.
es.R: Él da a la gente que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} honra lo que quiere. Cuando claman pidiendo ayuda, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los oye y los salva.

vi.L: Ước muốn của những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm thành; và tiếng kêu cầu của họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu họ.
vi.B: Ngài làm thành ước muốn của những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe tiếng họ kêu cứu và giải cứu họ.
vi.R: Ngài ban cho những người tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} điều họ mong muốn. Khi họ kêu cứu, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe và cứu họ.

decisions.choice: those who fear him: people who honor God
decisions.reason: To fear the LORD is to hold him in awe, trust him and obey him (34:10).
The word (shav'ah) is a call for help in trouble (18:7).
Readable says what this kind of fear is (m1).

source.text: שׁוֹמֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֹהֲבָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־הָרְשָׁעִ֣ים יַשְׁמִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: Keeping [is] YHWH all who love him, and all the wicked he will destroy.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] keeping all who love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, but all the wicked {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will destroy.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} guards everyone who loves {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will wipe out all the wicked.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} protects everyone who loves {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will destroy all wicked people.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] gardant tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aiment, mais tous les méchants, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les détruira.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veille sur tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aiment, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} anéantira tous les méchants.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} protège tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aiment. Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} détruira tous les méchants.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwenye kuwalinda wote wanaompenda, lakini waovu wote atawaangamiza.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} humlinda kila anayempenda, lakini atawafutilia mbali waovu wote.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} humlinda kila mtu anayempenda. Lakini atawaangamiza watu wote waovu.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} guarda a todos los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} aman, pero a todos los malvados {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} destruirá.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cuida a todo el que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ama, pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} acabará con todos los malvados.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} protege a todo el que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ama. Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} destruirá a toda la gente malvada.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng] gìn giữ mọi người yêu mến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nhưng mọi kẻ ác {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ tiêu diệt.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} canh giữ mọi người yêu mến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ tiêu diệt mọi kẻ ác.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bảo vệ mọi người yêu mến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ tiêu diệt mọi kẻ gian ác.

decisions.reason: The verb (shamar) is a guard's watching over what is in his care (121:3-8).
The "and" joins two opposite outcomes, as in 1:6, so it is "but" here.

source.text: תְּהִלַּ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה יְֽדַבֶּ֫ר־פִּ֥י וִיבָרֵ֣ךְ כָּל־בָּ֭שָׂר שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשׁ֗וֹ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] praise of YHWH my mouth will speak, and let all flesh bless [the] name of his holiness forever and ever.

en.L: The praise of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my mouth will speak, and let all flesh bless {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy name forever and ever.
en.B: With my own mouth I will speak praise to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; may all creatures bless {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy name for all time to come.
en.R: I will speak words of praise to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Let every living thing praise {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy name forever and ever!

fr.L: La louange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, ma bouche la dira, et que toute chair bénisse {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint nom à tout jamais !
fr.B: De ma bouche je dirai la louange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; que toutes les créatures bénissent {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint nom pour tous les temps à venir !
fr.R: Je dirai des paroles de louange pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Que tout ce qui vit loue {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint nom, pour toujours et à jamais !

sw.L: Sifa za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kinywa changu kitazisema, na wote wenye mwili walibariki jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu milele na milele.
sw.B: Kwa kinywa changu mwenyewe nitamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; viumbe vyote na vilibariki jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu nyakati zote zijazo.
sw.R: Nitasema maneno ya kumsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kila kiumbe hai na kilisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu milele na milele!

es.L: La alabanza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} hablará mi boca, y que toda carne bendiga {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo nombre por siempre jamás.
es.B: Con mi propia boca alabaré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; que todas las criaturas bendigan {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo nombre por todos los tiempos.
es.R: Diré palabras de alabanza {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. ¡Que todo ser vivo alabe {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo nombre por siempre jamás!

vi.L: Miệng tôi sẽ nói lời ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và nguyện mọi xác thịt chúc tụng danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi.
vi.B: Chính miệng tôi sẽ nói lời ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; nguyện mọi loài sinh vật chúc tụng danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ nói những lời ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Nguyện mọi loài có sự sống ca ngợi danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời mãi mãi!

decisions.reason: "All flesh" means everything that lives (Genesis 6:12-13; 136:25), or here perhaps all people. The psalm ends where verse 1 began, with blessing God's name, but now the call is for all to join in.

decisions.choice: the name of his holiness: his holy name
decisions.reason: A Hebrew way of saying "his holy name" (103:1).
Balanced and Readable say what "all flesh" means (m1).
